suite: 3D pane follows the selection (sweep, bind, reload, hover)
expect_red: [real] resting on a body row in the nav lights that body in the scene

mutations.contract: A pointer resting on a mirrored row runs that row's own hover in the annotator.
mutations.note: A row that renders and clicks but never passes the pointer over loses the coupling silently. Re-pointed 2026-11-10 (the_model_is_derived_once_and_the_left_column_is_its_tree): the nav is the model's tree and the pane's rows are drawn under the selected feature only. A body row's hover posts the pane's own `hover body` verb; the mirrored row's `enter` act is not on this path.
